changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Update transaction_transaction_status_check constraint to allow PARTIALLY_REFUNDED status
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the old constraint first so updates can succeed ALTER TABLE transaction DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS transaction_transaction_status_check;

-- Create new constraint with PARTIALLY_REFUNDED included ALTER TABLE transaction ADD CONSTRAINT transaction_transaction_status_check CHECK (transaction_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying::text, 'PENDING'::character varying::text, 'COMPLETED'::character varying::text, 'REFUNDED'::character varying::text, 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'::character varying::text, 'CANCELED'::character varying::text]));
